name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
tagline: India's dominant commodity derivatives exchange with excellent returns, but too large already for a 10x-in-2-3-year outcome
business_overview: MCX is India's largest commodity derivatives exchange, holding over 95% market share in commodity futures and options across bullion, energy, base metals, and agriculture.
fundamentals_table: FY26 consolidated revenue more than doubled to Rs 2,302 Cr, PAT above Rs 1,300 Cr
fundamentals_narrative: Business quality is excellent (near-monopoly market position, no debt, very high returns on capital) and growth has genuinely been strong (revenue doubled in FY26). But at Rs 81,215 Cr market cap this is a large-cap by any reasonable definition, and the strong growth already achieved is reflected in a rich 52.7x P/E -- there is no visible catalyst of the scale needed to justify a further 10x in 2-3 years from this base.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-dived this pass -- filtered on size/valuation before forum research, consistent with how other large-caps (PB Fintech, 360 One WAM, CG Power) were handled in this project earlier today.
community_signal: joinjp2003 (trusted, elevated-tier) made a repeat qualifying mention in his own portfolio thread (informational only, floor not active).
bull_case: Near-monopoly market structure with very high, debt-free returns on capital
Genuine recent growth (FY26 revenue more than doubled)
bear_case: Market cap (Rs 81,215 Cr) is too large for a 10x-in-2-3-year outcome absent an extraordinary catalyst, none of which is currently visible
Already-rich valuation (52.7x P/E) suggests the strong recent growth is largely priced in
verdict_headline: Excellent business, but size and valuation rule out the 10x-in-2-3-year thesis regardless of quality
verdict_reasoning: Consistent with prior large-cap filters in this project, market cap alone disqualifies a 10x-in-2-3-year outcome without an extraordinary, specific catalyst
No such catalyst is apparent -- current growth is already reflected in a 52.7x P/E
The trusted mention (joinjp2003) is informational only and does not override the size-based filter

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: 'market cap alone disqualifies a 10x-in-2-3-year outcome without an extraordinary, specific catalyst' (tam=no), and 'current growth is already reflected in a 52.7x P/E' (valuation=no); no moat/tailwind detail given beyond size.
